description: Export multiple markdown files as a single merged document or individual exports. Combine docs/ folders into one PDF, DOCX, or HTML.

files.description: List of markdown files to export

glob.description: Glob pattern to match markdown files (e.g., 'docs/**/*.md')

outputPath.description: Where to save the output file
